research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Amprius is engaged in research and development of nanostructures for lithium-ion battery electrodes, focusing on the structurally controlled deposition of silicon onto nanowires. Their work includes methods for fabricating a nanostructure template with a silicon coating, which may feature both a non-conformal, porous layer and a conformal, denser layer. These activities highlight Amprius’s focus on advanced silicon nanowire anode technologies for lithium-ion batteries.

overview_description.description: Amprius Technologies, Inc. is a leading manufacturer of high-energy and high-power lithium-ion batteries, producing the industry’s highest-known energy density cells. The Company’s commercially available SiCore® and SiMaxx™ batteries deliver up to 450 Wh/kg and 1,150 Wh/L, with third-party validation of 500Wh/kg and 1,300 Wh/L. The Company’s corporate headquarters is in Fremont, California, where it maintains an R&D lab and a MWh scale manufacturing facility for the fabrication of silicon anodes and cells.

product.name: SiCore®
product.description: A commercially available silicon-anode lithium-ion battery platform offering high energy density, rapid charging, high discharge power, and cycle life for aviation, drones, electric mobility, and industrial applications.

product.name: SiMaxx™
product.description: Amprius’ silicon-nanowire lithium-ion battery platform for applications requiring very high gravimetric and volumetric energy density, including aerospace, defense, unmanned aircraft, and advanced electric mobility.

product.name: SA128
product.description: A 21700 cylindrical silicon-anode lithium-ion cell with 6.8 Ah capacity and 320 Wh/kg energy density, intended for aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial battery packs.
